A: ‍Adaptability is key. ‍Each format has its unique requirements. For print, you have more space and can delve deeper into stories. online is more ‌concise and frequently enough includes multimedia elements. Broadcast, however, is ⁢about brevity and clarity, ⁤as visuals play a​ crucial role.‍ Practicing regularly and seeking feedback can ⁤significantly improve​ your adaptability.
